 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Welcome back to another live match day hub, as Crystal Palace take on Turkish side Beşiktaş.
 Halftime Beşiktaş 1-0 Palace
 Frustration is the main feeling. Palace have been excellent, a much improved first half, but the Eagles are down at the break.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The overall performance has been strong. Good defending, neat passing patterns and the press has been excellent. A slight switch off defensively, but a really good pass and finish put the hosts 1-0 up.
 Wharton looks much stronger, and his influence on the final third has been incredibly noticeable too.
 Yéremy Pino looks like Palace's best player by some distance too. Everything good goes through him. Mateta's presence in the side has also made a positive impact too.
 It's all about the reaction in the second half now. Palace can't afford to drop their heads.
 First Half
 45+2' 1-0 Goal for Beşiktaş. Wilfried Ndidi scores with the home side's first attempt on target in the half. Ndidi makes a run straight through the Palace defence and finishes well.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 34' 0-0 Mateta comes close again, this time from the resulting corner. He's bullied the Beşiktaş defenders so far, and should probably be on the scoresheet by now.
 33' 0-0 Side netting from Khalaili. Palace are on top big time here. Need to capitalise.
 30' 0-0 Huge chance for Mateta. Wharton swings the corner in and the Frenchman meets it on the volley, but his powerful strike is saved well by Nubel in goal.
 21' 0-0 Another chance for Palace, this time Mitchell goes close. Great pass through to him, he drives beyond the Beşiktaş backline but can't get his attempt on target.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 16 0-0 Mateta goes close again. Great volleyed ball through from Wharton and Mateta attempts to hit it first time over his shoulder, narrowly missing wide of the left post.
 15' 0-0 Wilfried Ndidi is shown the game's first yellow after hacking down Pino after some excellent pressing again. The subsequent freekick finds Richards, who heads just over the bar.
 13' 0-0 Great move from Palace. Wharton finds Pino who controls with his chest before returning to Wharton who overlaps inside the box. His cross is slightly ahead of Mateta.
 10' 0-0 Palace have reached the ten minute mark without conceding. I'm not going to remind you what the score was at this point last week.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 9' 0-0 Good work down the right from Beşiktaş but Khalaili clears well. Palace go up the other end and Mateta does well but loses the ball eventually.
 7' 0-0 Goal disallowed. Mateta slightly offside in the build up. Great start from Palace but it's ruled out.
 IMAGO / BSR Agency
 6' 0-1 GOOOOALLLLLLL JEAN -PHILIPPEEE MATETAAAAAA. A great move started with a long pass from Wharton. Neat play inside the box and the ball falls to Mateta who finishes well.
 1' 0-0 We're underway in Istanbul. COME ON YOU PALACE!
 IMAGO / ZUMA Press Wire
 Lineups!
 The big new for Palace is that Dwight McNeil starts on the right ahead of both Ismaila Sarr and Darío Osorio.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jean-Philippe Mateta also returns to the starting eleven, with Strand Larsen dropping to the bench.
 Walter Benítez makes his 50th European appearance.
 Leandro Trossard starts for the hosts, but captain and star midfielder Orkun Kökçü.
